models_evaluated: Dynamic Criticality Index (CI-D) multi-institutional neural network models

links.outcome: Multi-institutional model discrimination on local historical data versus reference outcome
links.effect: Multi-institutional CI-D models applied to single-site data had AUROC 0.493-0.545 and AUPRC 0.262-0.299, versus AUROC 0.946-0.948 in the multi-institutional dataset; local testing revealed failure.
links.quote: Models developed from multi-institutional datasets and intended for application to individual institutions should be assessed locally and may benefit from re-development with site-specific data prior to deployment.

links.outcome: Performance of multi-institutional versus locally re-developed models on single-site test data
links.effect: Single-site re-developed models achieved AUROC 0.906-0.944 and AUPRC 0.754-0.824, versus AUROC 0.493-0.545 for the multi-institutional models; calibration slopes 1.04-1.06 versus 0.344-0.406.
links.quote: The performance metrics of the single-site CI-D models applied to the single-site test sample ( Fig 2 , Table 2B ) were substantially better than the performance of the multi-institutional model.

links.outcome: Differences in model covariate importance and practice patterns between development and local setting
links.effect: 20%-30% of the top 30 covariates in multi-institutional models were not among single-site model top covariates; local practices (ICU admission policies, medications, coma score) differed, contributing to degraded performance.
links.quote: Among the full list of covariates, 20%-30% of the 30 most frequent covariates used for ICU predictions made in the multi-institutional models were not among the 30 most frequent variables in the single-site models.

links.outcome: Generalization of multi-institutional model to a new site not in development data
links.effect: Despite excellent performance in the multi-institutional dataset, AUROC fell to 0.493-0.545 and sensitivity to 0.007-0.008 at the new site.
links.quote: Despite excellent performance in an independent multi-institutional dataset [ 10 ], the multi-institutional models had substantially reduced performance in the single-site dataset.

unlisted_practices: Re-development of models using site-specific data with identical variables and methods
LIME-based variable importance comparison to identify local practice differences

links.effect: Multi-institutional CI-D on single-site data: AUROC = 0.493–0.545; AUPRC = 0.259–0.299; sensitivity 0.007–0.008 at threshold 0.5.
links.quote: For the four future prediction time periods, the AUROC = 0.493–0.545 ( Fig 1A ), and the AUPRC = 0.259–0.299 ( Fig 1B ).

links.effect: Single-site redevelopment: AUROC 0.906-0.944 and AUPRC 0.754-0.824, versus multi-institutional local AUROC 0.493–0.545.
links.quote: The single-site CI-D models applied to an independent single-site test dataset had an AUROC 0.906-0.944 and AUPRC range from 0.754-0.824.

links.effect: 20%-30% of top multi-institution covariates absent from single-site top 30; 17%-25% vice versa.
links.quote: Among the full list of covariates, 20%-30% of the 30 most frequent covariates used for ICU predictions made in the multi-institutional models were not among the 30 most frequent variables in the single-site models.

links.effect: Multi-institutional CI-D local AUROC = 0.493–0.545, AUPRC = 0.259–0.299 despite prior multi-institution AUROC = 0.946–0.948.
links.quote: Despite excellent performance in an independent multi-institutional dataset [ 10 ], the multi-institutional models had substantially reduced performance in the single-site dataset.

links.outcome: discrimination of multi-institutional model at local single site
links.effect: AUROC was 0.493-0.545 and AUPRC was 0.262-0.299 on single-site data, compared to AUROC 0.946-0.948 and AUPRC 0.726-0.742 in multi-institutional data
links.quote: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) for the multi-institutional CI-D models applied to a single-site test dataset was 0.493-0.545 and area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) was 0.262-0.299.

screen.reason: Evaluates external validation performance of a multi-institutional pediatric ICU prediction model at a single site versus re-training on local data, demonstrating the necessity of local validation and site-specific adaptation before deployment.
